name: 33570 · Ruskin, FL
findings: ZIP 33570 (Ruskin) has 69 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (37% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33570 (Ruskin) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33570 (Ruskin) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 42% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 41 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.
